sections.text: العمل الذي يتعين القيام به

Steps to prepare 
for test

Review technical reference material and 
 manufactures manual.

Obtain copy of setting values of the
 temperature switch and record it in its MPRDS.
Disconnect temperature switch wires and isolate the wires using tape
Remove temperature switch and take it to lab

items:
Review technical reference material and 
 manufactures manual.

Obtain copy of setting values of the
 temperature switch and record it in its MPRDS.
Disconnect temperature switch wires and isolate the wires using tape
Remove temperature switch and take it to lab

sections.text:
Calibrating 
procedure

Put the temperature switch into the oven and connect ohmmeter leads to 
 temperature switch contact terminals
ضبط

Inject the suitable pressure value reference to 
 setting and record at MRDS, using ohmmeter, check contact if change in its 
 situation.

If there is any error, using screw driver adjust 
 the switch and repeat step 1.

sections.text:
Return pressure 
switch to Service

Return the switch to service by removing the 
 pressure tester from the switch vent.
Close indicator vent.
Open manual valve for switch line.

Place a copy of test result in the field 
 maintenance file.
